correctness.rationale: For the normalized two-excitation Dicke state, a phase-free Hermitian Pauli string preserves Hamming weight two only for r=0,2,4 X/Y flips; odd Y parity cancels. The 0-flip signed Krawtchouk numerator, 2-flip exterior occupancy signs, and 4-flip six occupied-pair amplitudes give all labelled magnitude branches. Independently enumerating every 4^n Pauli string for n=4,5,6 from computational-state actions exactly reproduced each integer-scaled expectation and the formula T2(n)=4(91n^2-427n+492)/(n^3(n-1)^3). The all-real-alpha moment sum follows the exact flip-sector multiplicities. Binomial Rademacher CLT with subgaussian uniform integrability gives sector scalings n^(-2alpha), n^(2-3alpha), n^(4-4alpha); competition yields index-two three-sector crossover and n^4T_(2+s/log n)->60e^(-2s)+192e^(-3s)+112e^(-4s). Independence of asymptotic proof from finite checks is explicit. Domain n>=4, alpha>1.
